instruction:
Use the ANSYS Fluent GUI to complete the following analysis:

Physical problem: 2D Poiseuille flow (pressure-driven channel laminar flow).

Model parameters:
- Domain: rectangle, length 1000 mm, height 2 mm
- Fluid: water
- Mesh: structured quadrilateral mesh

Boundary conditions:
- Inlet: velocity inlet, mean velocity 0.1 m/s
- Outlet: pressure outlet, gauge pressure 0 Pa
- Top and bottom walls: stationary, no-slip

Analysis type: laminar steady-state analysis

Solver setup:
- Pressure-based solver, steady
- Laminar model
- Second-order schemes
- SIMPLE algorithm

Save requirements:
- Case and Data files: poiseuille_2d.cas and poiseuille_2d.dat
